annotation.bound_parties_text: The Decree applies to Vietnamese and foreign agencies, organizations and individuals involved in activities related to unmanned aircraft and other aerial vehicles in Vietnam, including importers/exporters, producers, traders, operators and pilots, and ministries and provincial People's Committees.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Decree applies to Vietnamese and foreign agencies, organizations and individuals involved in activities related to unmanned aircraft and other aerial vehicles (below referred to as aerial vehicles) in Vietnam.
annotation.dates_quote:
1. This Decree takes effect on November 5, 2025.
2. The provisions of Clauses 1 and 3, Article 19 of this Decree will take effect on July 1, 2026.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Decree No. 288/2025/ND-CP dated November 5, 2025 of the Government providing the management of unmanned aircraft and other aerial vehicles
